sentences.en: Now I have curly hair, because I had a perm.
sentences.zh: 现在我留着卷发，因为我做过烫发。

sentences.en: Your fine, curly hair looks as appetizing as glass noodles.
sentences.zh: 你的细软卷发看起来就像玻璃面条一样诱人。

sentences.en: A poodle typically has a dense coat of curly fur.
sentences.zh: 比熊犬通常有一层浓密的卷毛。

senses.zh: 有卷发的，长卷毛的,（木材）有皱状纹理的,蜷缩的,（植物）有卷叶病的
